defects.title: screen_intel reports success when its backend call fails
defects.evidence: backend/screen_intel.py:154-176 POSTs http://127.0.0.1:20128 (dead since 9Router removal); except branch returns "success": true with window-title/OCR text
defects.fix: return success:false + error; route vision model via free_router or disable feature

defects.title: /api/system/graph hardcodes PASS for 10 of 14 nodes
defects.evidence: backend/server.py:1027-1033,1036,1039-1040 literal "status":"PASS"; only frontier computed
defects.fix: compute each node from the same probes the doctor uses; unknown != PASS

defects.title: Doctor asserts literals for Core/Backend/Ingest
defects.evidence: server.py:1104-1105 chk("AEGIS Core", True) / chk("Backend API", True); :1162 uses ingest_daemon.running flag while all 4 poll loops are pass stubs (ingest_daemon.py:46-60)
defects.fix: probe real liveness (uptime counter, last-poll timestamp); add a NOT_IMPLEMENTED state

defects.title: /api/skills duplicates route and injects 3 synthetic skills
defects.evidence: server.py:891 and :978 both @app.get("/api/skills"); second injects ecc.code.analyze / frontier.research.deep / multica.coord when registry empty; aegis.log 'Failed to parse Hermes skill manifest' 2026-09-30 17:43,17:47
defects.fix: delete duplicate handler; fix Hermes manifest parse; never auto-inject

defects.title: VoiceStudio adapter returns canned audio and transcript via live POST routes
defects.evidence: backend/integrations/voicestudio/adapter.py:20 return b"fake_audio_data"; transcribe returns hardcoded string
defects.fix: raise NotImplementedError / return 501; or wire the real voxtype socket /run/user/1000/voxtype/audio.sock

defects.title: Multica adapter reports ASSIGNED then COMPLETED 100% with no work
defects.evidence: backend/integrations/multica/adapter.py:56-63
defects.fix: make assign/monitor raise until a real daemon exists; keep execution_core BLOCKED guard

defects.title: Test-residue cameras persisted as authorized + vision_enabled
defects.evidence: live GET /api/cameras: cam-2d077c85 name TestCam2 uri mock://uri authorized true vision_enabled true; duplicate 'Integrated Camera (cert run)' rows on /dev/video0; originated from tests/test_camera_e2e.py
defects.fix: purge mock/cert entries; point tests at a tmp registry via env; make killswitch durable; audit-log authorization

defects.title: Autonomy level not enforced by most actuators; 2 call sites inverted
defects.evidence: authorize() callers only agent_moe.py:57,71,84 + cloudroom_bridge.py:139-142; execution_core.py:190 and frontier_adapter.py:95 use 'if auto_approve and not authorize(...)'; PTY, code_sandbox, browser_tool, computer_control, /api/run-script have none
defects.fix: central authorize() at every side-effecting entry point; call unconditionally, let it decide

defects.title: Browser actuator reachable via unauthenticated GET
defects.evidence: server.py:805-815 GET /api/browser/{extract,screenshot,dom}; browser_tool validates scheme only; security.py:47 allow-lists governance family
defects.fix: require token on all actuator routes; host/URL allow-list; treat loopback service ports as denied

defects.title: 8 hardcoded cl/ model IDs cannot resolve; each use wastes a failing request
defects.evidence: backend/config.py:72-91 MODEL_DEFAULT/REASONING/FAST/LITE + FREE_CHAT_MODELS; free_router.py:489-495 sends unknown ID verbatim to OpenRouter then 60s cooldown; 4 slugs exist nowhere in repo
defects.fix: replace with live pool IDs from /api/models; add startup assertion that every configured ID resolves

defects.title: lmstudio/ and cactus/ can never be auto-selected
defects.evidence: free_router.py:313-340 emits only groq/ and openrouter/ although dispatch supports lmstudio at :480-483; /api/model-health shows lmstudio=detected, groq=standby
defects.fix: include local providers in candidate list when reachable; surface missing GROQ key in doctor

defects.title: Token gate blocks memory and sandbox POSTs the UI legitimately makes
defects.evidence: aegis.log 'Rejected request to /api/memory/mem0/add - bad/missing token' 2026-09-29 22:14 (x2); 'Rejected request to /api/sandbox/execute' 2026-09-30 17:43
defects.fix: implement one CSRF strategy for all mutating routes; mint the session cookie once at app boot

defects.title: Two memory stores frozen since 2026-09-27; writes fail silently
defects.evidence: turboquant_store.json 237 recs newest 09-27 13:15; mem0_store.json 61 recs newest 09-27 12:45; chat write inside 'except Exception: pass'
defects.fix: log+count write failures; single write fan-out with provenance; add /api/memory/status exposing per-store newest timestamp

defects.title: Four stores behind three read endpoints with no canonical search
defects.evidence: /api/memory/search -> CognitiveMemoryEngine (server.py:775-779) returned [] for q=camera while the vault holds camera notes; /api/memory/mem0/search and /api/turboquant/search read other stores
defects.fix: one /api/memory/query fanning out with per-source attribution; demote low-level routes to internals

defects.title: Synthetic test rows stored as knowledge
defects.evidence: turboquant source_id 'cert_test' = 'This is a certification test for turboquant storage.' and 'test_doc_1'
defects.fix: purge records whose source_id matches test/cert patterns; make cert scripts write to a scratch store

defects.title: consolidate runs ~96x/day via two competing timers; ingest double-enabled
defects.evidence: aegis-consolidate.timer and aegis-consolidate-daily.timer both OnUnitActiveSec=15min + OnBootSec=30sec on the same service, shared LastTriggerUSec; aegis-ingest enabled as service and timer; aegis-learn-loop.timer disabled-but-present
defects.fix: keep one 15-min timer, delete -daily; disable boot service if the timer owns it; delete the disabled unit

defects.title: aegis-frontend.service always reports active
defects.evidence: ExecStart=/usr/bin/true, Type=oneshot RemainAfterExit=yes -> is-active 'active (exited)'; aegis_health.py:120 probes such units
defects.fix: remove the unit or make it actually serve the SPA; health must probe the port, not the unit name

defects.title: npm run dev cannot work: port collision + proxy to dead 8787
defects.evidence: vite.config.ts:13-22 port 2981, /api -> http://127.0.0.1:8787, /ws -> ws://127.0.0.1:8787; stale comment src/lib/api.ts:3
defects.fix: dev port 5173, proxy target http://127.0.0.1:2981 (env-overridable); fix the comment
defects.verify: npm run dev; then curl -s localhost:5173/api/health returns ok

defects.title: Five orphan backend modules; vision path never called
defects.evidence: agent_runner, camera_cli, deepseek_harness, openclaw_harness, vision_pipeline each 0 importers; vision_pipeline import-broken; vision_engine.analyze_image_with_model 0 callers
defects.fix: delete or wire each; if kept, register an exclusion list + import-graph smoke test

defects.title: Two live model routers with fabricated metrics
defects.evidence: model_router.py live at server.py:1448, research_engine.py:79,173, task_planner.py:84; VERIFIED_MODEL_PROFILES hardcodes avg_latency 6.85 / reliability 1.0
defects.fix: migrate the 3 call sites to free_router, or compute metrics from real timings and rename VERIFIED_*

defects.title: 63 of 115 routes have no UI consumer; typed client bypassed
defects.evidence: api.ts covers 48 paths; 0 of 24 components import apiClient; direct fetch in AgentTabs.tsx, AgentTab.tsx, HomePanel.tsx, SpatialMemoryCanvas.tsx, api.ts:625-690
defects.fix: route groups to panels or delete; migrate panels to apiClient; add contract test diffing routes vs client
defects.verify: contract script reports 0 unconsumed non-admin routes

defects.title: WebSocket emits 2 of ~7 message types; subscribe_* dead at both ends
defects.evidence: broadcast() only at server.py:710 (pc_update) and :919 (script_result); initial_data computed-and-discarded per connection :2263-2275; key '9router_health' :2275
defects.fix: emit memory/execution/camera/vision events; drop initial_data or consume it; rename the wire key

defects.title: Hardcoded user paths and ports
